diagnosis: Customer asks whether the /v1/reporting endpoints are being retired and wants a timeline. KB-0007 confirms the v1 reporting endpoints stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01 and that v2 returns the same fields under a paginated envelope.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Yes, the v1 reporting endpoints are being deprecated. Per our published timeline, they will stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01. We recommend migrating your dashboard to the v2 reporting endpoints, which return the same fields under a paginated envelope. Please let us know if you need assistance planning the migration.
